name: @upup/pi-tui-app
description: UpUp TUI + Components Pi Package — Ink CLI shell consuming canonical Pi events and Session public API.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun --external react --external ink --external @earendil-works/pi-tui --external @earendil-works/pi-ai --external @upup/utils --external @upup/types --external @upup/commands --external @upup/hooks --external @upup/i18n --external @upup/pi-runtime --external @upup/pi-session --external @upup/pi-storage --external @upup/pi-resource-composition --external @upup/pi-capability-registry --external @upup/pi-permissions --external @upup/memory --external chalk && npx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir dist
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --watch --target=bun --external react --external ink --external @earendil-works/pi-tui --external @upup/utils --external @upup/types --external @upup/commands --external @upup/hooks --external @upup/i18n --external @upup/pi-runtime --external @upup/pi-session --external @upup/pi-resource-composition --external @upup/pi-capability-registry --external @upup/pi-permissions --external @upup/memory --external chalk
